policy: Positive concealed engagements are intended supports; exposed parts must not cross. Rigid lid motion only; no electrical or suction simulation.

vacuum_cleaner.airway: Actual bores at bag inlet, hose fittings, hose, grip, wand and articulated head. Dust bag inlet is recessed; bag porosity and motor internals are not simulated.
vacuum_cleaner.movement: Bag lid open close0–100 degrees, frames1–151. All other parts static/editable. Hidden concentric seating overlaps are intended; visible shell, wheels, roll and guards remain separated.
